parsed_json.up: Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activity rows against human single-protein target CHEMBL5145 (Serine/threonine-protein kinase B-raf). Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target ChEMBL ID, target_type SINGLE PROTEIN, tax_id 9606, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and non-null pchembl_value. Do not deduplicate rows. Sort by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id.
